assertions.assertion: Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring is coded with CPT 93229
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period

The clinical indication directly establishes that this diagnostic procedure is required to evaluate the patient's symptoms against their underlying diagnosis, satisfying the medical necessity standard that reason code CO-197 seeks to confirm
